mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause S&P 500 underperformance, generating negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening economic supply capacity, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 50,000 jobs signals significant labor market deterioration, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS declines by more than 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation acceleration (>0.3pp) and HOUST decline (>0.5%) indicate stagflationary pressures, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as growth slows and central banks delay easing.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp and HOUST declines > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp and HOUST declines > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During strong supply growth periods (INDPRO > 105.0), accelerating economic output drives S&P 500 outperformance, generating positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expand.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0.
